def: properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age

occurrences.text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.
And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the Lord.
